faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about creating pet art with Pet2Art.

items.title: What types of pets can I create art for?
items.description: Pet2Art works with all types of pets - dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, hamsters, horses, and more! As long as you have a clear photo of your pet, we can transform it into beautiful art.

items.title: What photo quality do I need for best results?
items.description: For best results, use a clear, well-lit photo where your pet's face is clearly visible. The photo should be at least 500x500 pixels. Avoid blurry or dark photos for optimal art generation.

items.title: How long does it take to generate pet art?
items.description: Our AI creates your pet portrait in about 2-3 minutes. Once generated, the high-resolution image will be automatically sent to your email address, no waiting required.

items.title: Can I use the generated art for commercial purposes?
items.description: Yes! Once you generate art with Pet2Art, you own full rights to use it however you wish - personal use, gifts, merchandise, or commercial purposes.

items.title: What resolution are the generated images?
items.description: All generated pet portraits are high-resolution images suitable for printing. The exact resolution depends on your selected aspect ratio, but all images are optimized for both digital display and physical printing.

items.title: Do you offer refunds if I'm not satisfied?
items.description: If you have refund requirements, please send a refund request to petart_studio@outlook.com. We will process your request within 3 business days.

items.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.description: You can cancel your subscription anytime by going to your account and clicking 'Cancel Subscription' in the 'My Orders' section. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.

items.title: What AI technology do you use?
items.description: We're an AI wrapper service that provides a user-friendly interface built on top of advanced models like GPT-4 Vision. We are an independent platform not affiliated with OpenAI or other AI providers. See our AI Disclosure page for full details.
